about: Posts of community researchers whose indicators feed IOC watch (CLAUDE.md 5ff, README 16.5b). tools/ioc_watch.py reads each post through X's public embed endpoint (text and images), reads the images with OCR (tesseract) and keeps the domains / IPs that are defanged in the text or carry a watched word of an incident. Add a post: its URL in `posts` (`words` optional - the incident words it is about; otherwise found from its text). The morning routine's x.com links in kqlPublished / posts of the threat notes are read too.
